$description: Closed vocabulary of motion patterns a PageSpec node may use. Each pattern has exactly one reducedMotionFallback (const-locked in the PageSpec schema). sourceHasFallback=false means the original site has no reduced-motion branch; the fallback is the design-repo's requirement for generated pages.

scramble-in.description: Per-character random-glyph scramble that settles left-to-right (or reversed) once the element enters the viewport (threshold 0.1, once).

stagger-fade.description: Deterministic per-character opacity fade (0.23 s, spread 290 ms, line groups +100 ms).

sticky-stage-sequence.description: Section is one of 4 contiguous scroll stages inside one sticky container 8 viewports tall (2 viewports per stage).

ring-cycle.description: 7 lime ellipses enter, cycle and exit with stage scroll progress.

signature-draw.description: Stroke-dash draw of the signature paths (len/720 s each, start 0.5 s) when 15% visible; resets on exit.

polarity-reveal.description: WebGL image layer fades from colour-negative to positive over 0.8 s when in view.

dot-wipe-hover.description: Hover swaps the card image to its hover image with an 18 px square-dot wipe over 0.42 s.

glass-scroll-rotate.description: Glass 3D model rotates/drifts with section scroll progress (damped, λ 6).

backdrop-scene.description: Full-viewport WebGL backdrop (bokeh streaks, falling stickers, dot overlay, warp cursor) driven by scene progress.

color-shift-past-threshold.description: Text switches label-1 -> white (300 ms ease-out) while the warp cursor covers the screen.

dot-iris-transition.description: Halftone dot iris covers/reveals the page (0.8 s, cubic-66) on entry, route change and menu toggle.

fade-presence.description: Opacity fade in/out (0.4 s, ease fade-presence) with unmount after exit.

scroll-thumb.description: Scroll thumb visible 3 s on mount and 2 s after each scroll (opacity 500 ms).

globe-spin.description: 6 meridian arcs flip with staggered SMIL scale loops (2600 ms).

pointer-trail.description: 16 px lime dot cells trail the pointer in the WebGL post pass (solid mode only).

lightbox-flip.description: Zoomed image flies from its inline rect to the viewport (FLIP 450 ms ease layout) over a dominant-colour backdrop.
